$comment: How your skills in config/skills are served over MCP by your memory server (claude.ai and other remote clients); agents on your PCs always get the full folders. The served copy must stay under 100 KB per file and 400 KB per skill. Per skill: 'exclude' drops folders (trailing /) or files, 'note' is added to the top of the served SKILL.md. Example: "my-skill": { "exclude": ["engine/"], "note": "Served without its local engine." }
